page.notes: The tetragrammaton is printed as spaced capitals I E H O V A, with a final V-like glyph that is not clearly legible; copied as IEHOVA. The sign after "bonitate" and "eruditione" is a flourish, read as an abbreviation mark (⁓) and not certain. "cæteros" is set with a ligature-like initial; marked [?]. No margin notes, page number or signature visible. Lower right "dentiam" is treated as catchword.
